rv.q: As a production it is imperfect but heroic in all it is trying to say about the way we live, how we might live differently and escape the toxicity of the digital world.
Whether Martin Crimp's witty but underpowered new version affords the best showcase for Oh's abilities is another matter.

cn.t: Sandra Oh stars in Martin Crimp's modernized, gender-flipped Misanthrope, but critics find the high-wire adaptation only moderately successful, lacking the seductive punch it aims for.

ru.inst: Released Fridays at 1 PM via the National Theatre website (random queue).
